description: This file defines a Java interface 'MappingStrategies' meant for mapping adaptable objects to signals in a protocol adapter. It includes method signatures for retrieving appropriate mappers based on a type string.

classes.name: MappingStrategies
classes.description: An interface specifying strategies for mapping 'Adaptable' objects to signals, with a method to find a suitable JSONifiableMapper based on a type string.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a 'JsonifiableMapper' for a given type, or null if none is found.
